content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Fredericksburg

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility requirements—typically a bachelor's degree plus three years of project experience, or a high school diploma plus five years. Verify your credentials meet the standard before enrolling in Granite PM Academy's course.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Certification Training course. Attend all 35 required contact hours delivered by active certified practitioners. Our flexible scheduling accommodates working professionals across Fredericksburg's diverse industries, from healthcare and government contracting to education and financial services.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After completing your 35-hour course, submit your PMP application directly to PMI. Include proof of your education, project experience, and course completion. Pay PMI's exam fee to finalize your application and schedule your exam appointment.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Granite PM Academy provides exam-preparation resources and practice materials to reinforce course concepts. Study independently and attend optional review sessions. Take the computerized exam at a Pearson VUE testing center, answering questions across project-management domains and real-world scenarios.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to a three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through education, project work, or community involvement. Renew your credential by submitting your PDUs and renewal fee to PMI before expiration.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
